snippet.title: 【DIGIMON UP】 Coming Soon 2026! Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready for a brand-new Digimon mobile game, DIGIMON UP, coming in 2026!

To celebrate the announcement, a teaser trailer is now available.

A highly anticipated new entry in the Digimon series, built around the concept:
“A Digimon journey that moves with your life.”

This game even comes with brand new pixel art,
and you'll encounter lots of familiar Digimon components when playing!
